entries.label: Lobito — Ruins Lower
entries.scene: Ruins Lower 3A on Lobito Island in the original Metal Gear AC!D. Reconstruct the environment shown: ancient or abandoned heavy rough stone rectangular masonry, mossy dark green stone paving, thick square pillars and narrow rectangular passage openings, low broken walls, a short broad worn stone stair rising to an upper walkway at the back. Deep olive-green shadow, damp weathering, small tufts of vegetation in joints. Preserve the angular blocky ruin layout visible in the isometric game frames, translated to one side-on lane. No gothic arches, no ornate temple, no jungle hut, no futuristic lab. This image covers LOWER RUINS only, not forest or upper ruins.
